sourceStatus: PROPOSED_EXPANSION — historical reconstruction, not CP9 Canon
scope: Father-generation Red Claw household, several decades before campaign date 20 Ironmonth 105 AW.
knownCanonAnchors: Christian Red III is Christian Red IV’s father; his exact dates and detailed profile are not supplied in CP9.
Mirelda Grotsen is Christian IV’s stepmother and originates from House Grotsen.
The requested historical staffing includes three male domestic servants and five female Iron Guard members.
The current five female household attendants and Elara’s current five-woman Iron Guard detail are distinct populations and must not be reused as historical identities.

proposedTimeline.period: Approx. 76–98 AW. The frame is proposed; exact opening and closing dates are UNKNOWN.
proposedTimeline.father: Christian Red III; proposed birth 6 First Light 40 AW and proposed death 19 Ironmonth 98 AW. Neither date is established by CP9.
proposedTimeline.stepmother: Mirelda Grotsen; proposed birth 8 First Light 44 AW. Her Grotsen origin and stepmother status are Canon; age, marriage date and arrival date are proposed.
proposedTimeline.player: Christian Red IV; age 6–28 during 76–98 AW, conditional on proposed DOB 15 First Light 70 AW.
proposedTimeline.halfSister: Helena Red-Grotsen; proposed birth 2 First Light 80 AW; age 0–18 during the remainder of the period.
proposedTimeline.departure: Proposed in 98 AW after Christian III’s death: Mirelda and Helena depart for the Grotsen Dominion. Exact departure date and status of the eight staff remain UNKNOWN.

compositionRules.adultCore: 10 persons: father (1), stepmother (1), male servants (3), female Iron Guard (5).
compositionRules.76to79: 11-person named snapshot: 10 adult core + Christian IV as a dependent.
compositionRules.80to97: 12-person named snapshot: 10 adult core + Christian IV + Helena.
compositionRules.after98: No complete count: father deceased; Mirelda and Helena proposed to depart; Christian IV remains linked to the household. Staff disposition UNKNOWN.
compositionRules.exclusions: No temporary visitors, staff dependants, off-site guards, guests, or medical referrals counted. This is not a complete floor census.

authorityModel.householdHead: Christian Red III holds final domestic authority in this proposed reconstruction, subject to Red Claw law and higher political authority.
authorityModel.stepmother: Mirelda holds senior family standing through marriage and motherhood; she is not automatically Iron Guard commander or household steward.
authorityModel.steward: Arno Bittner administers staff, accounts, duties and domestic services under the household head.
authorityModel.guardCommand: Ragna Stahl commands the five-woman detail. Guard orders remain professional security orders, not domestic-service instructions.
authorityModel.servants: Markus Fenn and Pavel Kessler report through domestic administration; neither commands guards.

historicalArchitecture.status: PROPOSED layout framework only. CP9 does not establish a room-by-room historic residential plan. Do not assume the current Floor 6 Dome is identical to this earlier configuration.

zones.name: Reception vestibule

zones.access: Invited guests; movement coordinated with Guard.

zones.name: Family apartments
zones.purpose: Separate chambers for head of household, Mirelda and children.

zones.name: Steward office and ledger desk
zones.purpose: Duty rosters, expense ledger, maintenance requests and authorised records.
zones.access: Arno and household head; limited staff access.

zones.name: Servants’ quarters
zones.purpose: Rest and personal storage for the three domestic servants.

zones.name: Guard post and equipment room
zones.purpose: Shift handover, access register and readiness for the five-person detail.
zones.access: Iron Guard detail; steward receives reports, not unrestricted entry.

zones.name: Kitchen, pantry and dining room
zones.purpose: Food preparation, storage, meal service and family dining.
zones.access: Markus, assigned kitchen workers, family and approved guests.

zones.name: Study and instruction room
zones.purpose: Age-appropriate literacy, history, household learning and supervised instruction.

zones.name: First-aid / recovery room
zones.purpose: Proposed basic treatment and temporary recovery; no specialised diagnosis or equipment assumed.
zones.access: Medical personnel and patient; Guard only on legitimate security need.

zones.name: Stores and service passage
zones.purpose: Household supplies, cleaning tools, deliveries and waste handling.

personnel.name: Arno Bittner
personnel.background: Newly proposed historical household personnel; no Red Claw blood relation is asserted.
personnel.appearance: Square-set, neat hair kept close, work coat with a narrow key ring. No height or exact measurements assigned.
personnel.personality: Exacting, calm and procedural; prefers written orders to verbal promises.
duties: Staff duty roster and leave register
personnel.routine: First ledger check before breakfast; assignments after the morning report; accounts in the afternoon; roster confirmation before evening watch.
personnel.knowledgeBoundary: Household finances and authorised staff movements only.
eventHooks: An old ledger conflicts with a family recollection
a missing supply receipt forces an audit.

personnel.name: Markus Fenn
personnel.background: Newly proposed historical household personnel; no Red Claw blood relation is asserted.
personnel.appearance: Broad hands, flour or chalk often on his sleeves, hair tied back while working. No height or exact measurements assigned.
personnel.personality: Methodical, practical and plain-spoken; dislikes waste and last-minute changes.
personnel.routine: Inspects stores early; coordinates preparation before meals; counts deliveries after midday; closes the food ledger at day end.
personnel.knowledgeBoundary: Food orders and household quantities only; no medical or private relationship records.
eventHooks: an old ration book reveals an unusual household gathering.

personnel.name: Pavel Kessler
personnel.background: Newly proposed historical household personnel; no Red Claw blood relation is asserted.
personnel.appearance: Lean, quick-footed, ink on one thumb; dresses plainly. No height or exact measurements assigned.
personnel.personality: Discreet, observant and cautious with gossip; remembers names and dates.
personnel.routine: Collects letters at first bell; carries authorised notices; updates visitor book; sorts routine archive material late afternoon.
personnel.knowledgeBoundary: Only messages he is authorised to deliver or record; sealed messages remain sealed.
eventHooks: A misdirected letter arrives under an obsolete title
a visitor claims an appointment absent from the register.

personnel.name: Ragna Stahl
personnel.rank: PROPOSED — not a CP9 rank record
personnel.background: Newly proposed historical household personnel; no Red Claw blood relation is asserted.
personnel.appearance: Compact, strong posture, dark hair secured beneath duty gear. No height or exact measurements assigned.
personnel.personality: Direct, disciplined and protective without confusing security authority with domestic authority.
duties: Command of the five-woman residential detail
personnel.routine: Inspects posts at shift changes; receives security requests; leads route inspection; closes watch report.
personnel.knowledgeBoundary: Security matters and direct observations; no private family access without a legitimate security basis.
eventHooks: A later service record disputes a watch commander
an access rule is challenged at a reception.

personnel.rank: PROPOSED — not a CP9 rank record
personnel.background: Newly proposed historical household personnel; no Red Claw blood relation is asserted.
personnel.appearance: Short-cropped hair, measured stance, gloves clipped to belt. No height or exact measurements assigned.
personnel.personality: Patient with routine, firm with unauthorised access, dislikes public confrontation.

personnel.rank: PROPOSED — not a CP9 rank record

personnel.name: Selma Holt
personnel.role: Iron Guard / night watch and incident recorder
personnel.rank: PROPOSED — not a CP9 rank record
personnel.background: Newly proposed historical household personnel; no Red Claw blood relation is asserted.
personnel.appearance: Steady gaze, hair beneath a dark cap during duty. No height or exact measurements assigned.

personnel.routine: Takes evening handover; patrols assigned routes; logs incidents as observed; provides written dawn handover.
personnel.knowledgeBoundary: What occurred on her watch and what is in the log; rumours remain rumours.
eventHooks: A night log contains a gap needing corroboration
a harmless sound is misreported as an incident.

postDeathTransition: Record Christian Red III as deceased only after the proposed date is accepted by the canon authority.
Mirelda and Helena may receive a departure event to the Grotsen Dominion, subject to event confirmation and date validation.
Do not automatically transfer, dismiss or kill any of the eight historical personnel. Their post-death status remains UNKNOWN until an authored transition event assigns it.
Christian IV’s household authority, residence and inheritance follow the existing succession system; this file grants no new legal rights.
Preserve historical staff as archived personnel, not current active CAST entries.
validationWarnings: All eight staff names, roles, personalities and assignments are proposals, not CP9 identities.
Exact dates for Katharina’s death, Christian III’s remarriage, Mirelda’s arrival, Helena’s birth and the father’s death are not canonically supplied.
The father’s motive for promoting Christian IV’s first marriage is not Canon. Any private warning or marriage-arrangement dialogue is proposal-only.
The historical five Guard members are not Elara’s current Guard team. No identity reuse is allowed.
No exact floor number, chamber adjacency or architectural footprint is asserted for this historical period.
